title: Q-LocalAdam: Memory-Efficient Client-Side Adaptive Optimization for Edge Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2605.17552v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: On-device federated learning (FL) on edge devices is limited by the memory required by client-side adaptive optimizers. Maintaining optimizer states locally increases memory usage and can restrict the size of models that can be deployed on resource-constrained edge devices. State quantization can reduce this memory footprint, but uniform compression methods may perform poorly under skewed, non-IID data distributions because they can lose small-variance values that are important for stable optimization.   We present \textbf{Q-LocalAdam}, a distribution-aware optimizer for memory-constrained edge devices. It applies block-wise linear quantization to the bounded momentum state and log-space quantization to the heavy-tailed variance state. A post-dequantization variance floor is used to maintain numerical stability. translated_title: Q-LocalAdam：面向边缘联邦学习的内存高效客户端自适应优化
translated_abstract: 设备端联邦学习（FL）在边缘设备上受到客户端自适应优化器所需内存的限制。在本地维护优化器状态会增加内存使用量，并可能限制可在资源受限的边缘设备上部署的模型规模。状态量化可以减少这种内存占用，但均匀压缩方法在偏斜的非独立同分布（non-IID）数据分布下可能表现不佳，因为它们会丢失对稳定优化至关重要的低方差值。我们提出了 Q-LocalAdam，一种面向内存受限边缘设备的分布感知优化器。它对有界动量状态应用分块线性量化，对重尾方差状态应用对数空间量化，并通过反量化后的方差下限来保持数值稳定性。Q-LocalAdam 在降低持久性优化器状态内存占用的同时，实现了接近全精度训练的收敛效果。
tldr: 提出分布感知的量化优化器 Q-LocalAdam，通过对动量状态进行分块线性量化、对重尾方差状态进行对数空间量化并设置反量化后方差下限，在内存受限的边缘联邦学习中显著降低优化器状态内存占用，同时保持接近全精度训练的收敛性能。
en_tdlr: Q-LocalAdam is a distribution-aware optimizer that applies block-wise linear quantization to momentum states and log-space quantization to heavy-tailed variance states with a post-dequantization variance floor, reducing optimizer-state memory footprint in edge federated learning while achieving convergence close to full-precision training.
